title: Classic British Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole filled with tender chicken and vegetables, inspired by traditional British cuisine.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sliced mushrooms, carrots, and onions. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the heavy cream and diced tomatoes.
Transfer the casserole mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
